user_story: As an agency user, I want to submit my data elements surrounded by quotation marks, so that Excel won't strip off leading and trailing zeroes.
plantuml:
Here is the sequence diagram for the given user story:

```plantuml
@startuml
actor AgencyUser
actor System

AgencyUser -> System: Submit Data Elements
System -> System: Validate Data Elements
System -> AgencyUser: Display Validation Result

activate AgencyUser

loop until data elements validated
    AgencyUser -> System: Review Validation Result
    if (validation successful) then 
        System -> System: Store Validated Data
        AgencyUser -> System: Confirm Submission
    else 
        AgencyUser -> System: Revise Data Elements
    end
    
end

deactivate AgencyUser
@enduml
```

In this sequence diagram, we have an Agency User who submits their data elements to the system. The system validates these data elements and displays the validation result to the user. If the validation is successful, the system stores the validated data and confirms the submission with the user. If not, the user revises the data elements until they are valid. This loop continues until all data elements have been successfully validated and stored.
